title: Cypress Breeze Farm
specs: Located in Pinellas County, only trail riding operation in the county
Experienced guides and well-trained horses for riders of all levels
Horses receive top care and are matched to riders' ability
Trail ride participants must be ages 6 and up; up to 2 children under 12 per group of 6 riders
Children under 18 must wear helmet and have a paying adult with them on trail rides
All trail ride guests must ride their own horse
includes: Photos included in trail ride and provided via Google Drive
blurb: Cypress Breeze Farm provides horseback riding experiences for all ages and levels, including trail rides, hand-led pony rides for young kids or nervous riders, and horse-themed educational encounters. Lessons are offered for beginners through advanced riders, and small group sizes ensure personalized experiences. The farm also offers horse-drawn carriage rides for holiday events and private bookings. Some offerings can be brought off-site for events.
extraNote: Advance purchase required for trail rides; no walk-ups · Trail rides by appointment only
